title: DocTalkBN: A Novel Dataset of Expert Telemedicine Conversations in Bengali
abstract: arXiv:2608.27110v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reliable medical conversational AI requires authentic expert--patient interaction data, yet such datasets remain scarce, especially for low-resource languages such as Bengali. We present DocTalkBN, a large-scale multimodal dataset of real-world expert telemedicine conversations in Bengali, collected from nationally broadcast telemedicine programs featuring board-certified physicians. DocTalkBN contains 557.63 hours of paired audio and text, 1,515 multi-turn patient calls, 10,274 host--doctor question--answer exchanges, totaling 1.7M tokens, spanning 26 medical specialties. Unlike prior resources derived from medical forums, written health content, or synthetic data, our dataset preserves the spontaneity, contextual richness, and spoken characteristics of authentic medical interactions in a low-resource setting. To support benchmark-driven research, we further construct three downstream tasks from the corpus, medical triage classification

translated_title: DocTalkBN：孟加拉语专家远程医疗对话的新型数据集
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.27110v1 公告类型：新 摘要：可靠的医疗对话式人工智能需要真实的专家与患者互动数据，然而此类数据集仍然稀缺，尤其是对于孟加拉语等低资源语言。我们提出了DocTalkBN，一个从全国播出的、由委员会认证医生参与的远程医疗节目中收集的孟加拉语真实专家远程医疗对话的大规模多模态数据集。DocTalkBN包含557.63小时的配对音频和文本、1,515次多轮患者通话、10,274次主持人-医生问答交流，总计170万个词元，覆盖26个医学专科。与先前基于医学论坛、书面健康内容或合成数据的资源不同，我们的数据集保留了低资源环境下真实医疗互动的自发性、上下文丰富性和口语特征。为支持基准驱动的研究，我们进一步从语料库中构建了三个下游任务，包括医疗分诊分类。
tldr: 本文提出了DocTalkBN，一个大规模、多模态的孟加拉语真实专家远程医疗对话数据集，包含557.63小时音频文本和三个下游任务，填补了低资源语言医疗对话AI的数据空白。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces DocTalkBN, a large-scale multimodal dataset of authentic Bengali expert telemedicine conversations with 557.63 hours of audio-text data and three downstream tasks, filling the data gap for conversational AI in low-resource medical settings.
